reference.attribution: Yang, Krishnamurthy and Brown, IEMDC 2013, as transcribed in Pyleecan's validation test
reference.single_point_test: 82 Nm +/-10% at 60 degrees; the 13-angle reference vector separately starts at 79 Nm

source_identity.source_role: Published reference vector and operating points; not an independently verified hardware measurement dataset

registration.current_policy: Unmodified Pyleecan InputCurrent/OPdq -> OutElec.get_Is; no manual angle fit
registration.torque_policy: Pyleecan comp_FEMM_torque / FEMM weighted stress integral 22 on all rotor groups

registration.angle_policy: Published Pyleecan rotor/current axes; corrected geometry d-axis zero at 285 electrical degrees, established independently by no-load flux (phase A offset +75 degrees). No torque fit.
Published Pyleecan rotor/current axes; corrected geometry d-axis zero at 285 electrical degrees, established independently by no-load flux (phase A offset +75 degrees). No torque fit.

canonical_source.changes: Correct source provenance metadata, always write complete resumed waveform, wrap long lines. No field equations/source values/torque calculations changed.

study_plan.primary_torque: Arithmetic mean of independently solved weighted-stress rotor samples

sampling_control.coarsening: Eight actual poses versus their four even-indexed poses at all current angles
sampling_control.additional_refinement: Sixteen Pyleecan/FEMM poses at 60 and 140 current degrees

study_plan.reference_policy: Retain all thirteen Yang-2013 reference points without fitting angle, turns, geometry or materials; preserve separate upstream 82 Nm +/-10% single-point test.
study_plan.corrected_temperature_policy: Scale corrected fixture Br by .96, matching Pyleecan alpha_Br=-.001/K over 20 to 60 C; an imposed common temperature law, not measured OEM magnet properties.
study_plan.scope: 2D imposed sinusoidal-current magnetostatics. No voltage limit, thermal equilibrium, inverter losses or loaded 3D validation.
